 Real Sociedad and Lyon: Recent results
 Real Sociedad have three wins, one draw and one defeat from their last five competitive matches. They most recently lost 1-2 to Athletic Bilbao in La Liga. Before that came an emphatic 6-0 Europa League win against Lilleström, along with away wins at Malaga (5-2) and Levante (2-1). Real Sociedad scored 15 goals and conceded 10 across those five matches.
 Lyon have three wins, no draws and two defeats from their last five matches. They most recently beat Angers 2-0 in Ligue 1, having also beaten Crystal Palace 3-2 and Nice 2-1. Defeats against Paris Saint-Germain (0-2) and Hoffenheim (0-3) in the Europa League complete that run. Lyon scored eight goals and conceded eight during the period.
